articles.title: Crypto custody specialist Fireblocks denies it's in talks to be acquired by Visa
articles.snippet: The company is in talks with Visa over a potential $2.5 billion acquisition, Axios reported.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.snippet: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls back to $81,000, with interest rates tumbling as stocks crack
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq is down more than 2% as the AI bull market trade continues to unwind. U.S. interest rates are plunging even as oil surges.

articles.title: New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
articles.snippet: The request follows an August 2025 default judgment, with the AG also announcing nearly $6 million in settlements with four promoters.

articles.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
articles.snippet: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.
